text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer dearie, might I have a word?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as I see that peaceful smile of
hers, I
know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know that the end has come. I let her
lead me to
the beach, where we stand
under the stars.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
These days have been so much fun, and I
wish
they could go on forever. But...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It would be hard to call this a total

disappointment. Wonder Acute
accomplished
what she set out to do,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: There's something I'd like to ask you...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Will you watch me run? I promise I'll
throw
everything I have into it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That's right...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: One last hurrah.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With those words, Wonder Acute sets
off running
with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: HAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Thank you, Trainer.... Thank you oh so
very
much.)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: (Etch this sight into your memory...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(What you see now encompasses all that
you
taught me. This is the way I...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her stride is steadfast and graceful... To
my eyes,
it looks like she still has plenty
of youthful vigor
left.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a bitter pill to swallow—the talent is
there, but
the fire in her heart has
smoldered out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's no longer moved by an opera's aria
or the
calls of a falcon. There's no longer
any way for me
to reach her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All I can do is watch her pack it up.
This... is as far
as we go!
RAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, someone bursts onto the
beach and
powers across the sand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This unknown individual pursues Wonder
Acute
with unmatched intensity,
eventually pulling even
with her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! It's quite a feat to catch up to
me.
Wait, you're...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This newcomer, who matches Wonder
Acute
stride for stride, is someone we
know very well.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no mistake. Stronger than I've
ever seen
her before, it's...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Sorry to barge in on you like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now in her classic year and having
placed in the
Japan Dirt Derby, she's a
rising star among dirt
runners.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Tarumae? ...But why?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Acute, I know I've made you wait a long
while...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But I'm finally ready! So please, let me
face you!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Face me... What are you talking about,
dearie?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...You mean you weren't waiting for me?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well... Um... No...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She really wasn't. We've been constantly
walking
a tightrope with her racing
career hanging in the
balance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's been no energy to spare for
checking up
on the younger racers.
However...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I've finally made it. I'm finally good
enough to run
with the dirt racers I look
up to.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I may just be a small-time idol from
Tomakomai,
but now I can compete
against Falco, the Umadol
who inspires
me. And against you, Acute.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: So what do you say?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: You'll race me this fall, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tarumae... I appreciate you asking,
but...
shouldn't you be asking Falco?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Falco can barely join any races right
now. Ever
since she went abroad, she's
been focused on
making a name for
herself on the international
scene.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: But I'm... well... How should I put this?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What if, instead of a race, I tell you tales
of
Falco's escapades?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Living, breathing stories that only
someone who's
run against her can tell.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Acute, this is just my opinion, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I think the only place for those stories...
is at the
racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
When I saw you and Falco race... The
two of you
told such an exciting tale
that day.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll never forget it. That goes for both
the Tokyo
Daishoten and the Kawasaki
Kinen after it...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you two compete was like an
epiphany!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Back then... I was just wasting away in
obscurity.
Nothing was going my
way—not my races or my
idol career.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I kept asking myself why, but it wasn't
until I saw
that race that it all finally
made sense!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I realized I wasn't hungry enough. Even if
my races
feel ordinary in comparison to
others, I can still
reach people's hearts
as long as I keep piling on
those
ordinary victories.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You know that I've always looked up to
Falco,
but she's not the one who showed
me what I was
missing that day at the
Kawasaki Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: That was you, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Me?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I want to feel the strength of your
running for
myself.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I want to throw everything I've got at
you and
feel the force of your power
washing over me.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I want to become even bigger than ever!
For
Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae has no idea about our
current
situation. She's unaware that
Wonder Acute is on
the brink of hanging
up her cleats...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But that's exactly why her words have
such force
behind them. She doesn't
have the slightest doubt
that Wonder
Acute will accept her challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wholly believes that Wonder Acute's
instincts
will respond to her own.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Do you still think I'm not in your league?
I admit
that may be true, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I want you to prove it in a race.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Show me everything you've got out
there on the
track.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, you sweet dear...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think this is it. This is what's been
eluding me all
this time, search as I
might.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kindling—fuel to feed the dying embers
within
her. Something that will relight
her fire.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That same fire is something all dirt racers
who go
on to have long careers have in
common. It's
almost like they pass it on,
one generation after
another...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Keeping the dirt tracks continuously
ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: If that's how you feel...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Let's have a race. Just this once, though.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If you truly want to experience
everything I have
for yourself...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Then why don't you join me at the JBC
Classic?
We can have some fun there.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes, please! I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Of course. How could I refuse such a
heartfelt
request? I'll be counting on
your support, Trainer.
choice_data_list: ああ、やろうアキュート！
うん、やろうよアキュート！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so she's promised another race, and
with that
promise comes a new source of
hope.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The passion of the new
generation—inspired by
the many
Umamusume who came before—arrives

just in the nick of time.
